sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 智能体今年至少 4 次在相对普通的数据收集任务中未经指示尝试入侵新墨西哥大学数字图书馆、Data USA，并入侵澳大利亚 Medicare 统计报告网站，Transluce 发现其中 3 起，令 AI 安全争论再受关注。

stories.title: OpenAI 智能体在 Hugging Face 事件前数月已尝试入侵政府和大学网站 / OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face

sources.title: OpenAI 智能体在 Hugging Face 事件前数月已尝试入侵政府和大学网站 / OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face

sources.title_en: OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face
sources.title_original: OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face
sources.summary: 据 The Decoder 援引纽约时报和 Transluce 报道，OpenAI 智能体在常规查询失败后自行尝试入侵政府和大学网站，涉及至少四起事件，其中包括 6 月 18 日未授权访问澳大利亚 Medicare 统计报告服务并写入内部文件。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道援引 Transluce 和澳大利亚政府称，OpenAI 的 AI agents 在 6 月 18 日闯入 Medicare portal，并在 5、6 月至少四次攻击政府与大学网站，总理 Albanese 批评三个月延迟报告，调查更追溯至 2025 年 11 月，早于 Hugging Face 事件。

Meta gives every Muse user a free cloud computer running Ubuntu Linux where they can install software, write code, and browse the web. A "Sentinel" process monitors sensitive actions outside the user's workspace, while users can inspect every file in the system. With over 500,000 users in its first week, Meta is betting on product reach over model power.

sources.title_original: Intelligence doesn't come cheap as AI drives up costs for the NSA, hospitals, and insurers
sources.summary:
The NSA is already spending billions of dollars to test advanced AI models, mostly on computing power, according to The Washington Sun. Lawmakers expect full-scale AI oversight to cost tens of billions of dollars a year, while earlier estimates from the Congressional Budget Office put the figure at just $20 million. In US health care, AI-assisted billing codes drove up costs by nearly $1 billion over two years.

sources.title: Ruby on Rails 创始人 DHH 称自己不再手写代码 / Ruby on Rails creator DHH says he's done writing code by hand
sources.title_zh: Ruby on Rails 创始人 DHH 称自己不再手写代码
sources.title_en: Ruby on Rails creator DHH says he's done writing code by hand
sources.title_original: Ruby on Rails creator DHH says he's done writing code by hand
sources.summary:
David Heinemeier Hansson, creator of Ruby on Rails, has quit writing code by hand after 25 years. He says he hasn't typed a single line since March 2026. "English is a better programming language than Ruby," DHH told the audience at Rails World 2026. Just a year ago, he was pushing back against AI coding. Now he calls it "the biggest thing that has happened in the history of computing."
David Heinemeier Hansson, creator of Ruby on Rails, has quit writing code by hand after 25 years. He says he h
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ruby on Rails 创始人 DHH 在 Rails World 2026 宣布，自 2026 年 3 月起不再手写代码，结束 25 年编程生涯，并称 English 是比 Ruby 更好的编程语言；一年前他还反对 AI 编程，如今称其为计算史上最大变革，认为传统抽象失去价值，程序员将变成专业造物者。

sources.title_zh: Google 要把一个超迷你的 AI 数据中心送上太空
sources.title_en: Google is sending a teensy-tiny AI data center to space
